Simple purées

Sweet potato purée

Édesburgonyapüré

6 months+ Sound idea 45 min 4 portions

A few teaspoons is a full first taste. The flavour is already sweet.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 400 g sweet potatoes (whole weight before baking)
  • 4 tbsp water or breast milk (only to loosen)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 200°C.
  2. Prick the sweet potatoes and bake until the flesh is very soft, about 40 minutes.
  3. Cool enough to handle, then scoop the flesh out of the skins.
  4. Mash or blend until smooth, with a spoon of water or breast milk if it is stiff.
  5. Do not add salt or sugar.

Sound idea

This is a strong first food, and the usual mistake is seasoning it.

Bake, scoop, and loosen the flesh. Keep salt and sugar out, and nothing else needs to change.
